City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MAY 14, 2014 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Proclamation to the La Costa Canyon Boys Basketball Team
4B.
Proclamation for Public Works Week
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 4/9/14 Regular Meeting, the 4/16/14 Special Meeting and the 4/16/14 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2014-05-14 Item 08A - Minutes UPDATED
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2014-05-14 Item 08B - Warrants
8C.
Bike to Work Month, May 2014 and Bike to Work Day, May 16, 2014. Contact Person: Deputy City Manager Phillips
Adopt Resolution 2014-36, proclaiming May as Bike to Work Month and May 16, 2014, as Bike to Work Day.
2014-05-14 Item 08C - Bike to Work Month
8D.
Adoption of Ordinance No. 2014-05 amending Municipal Code Section 2.20 regarding duties and salary for the elected Mayor, Deputy Mayor and Council Members. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adoption of Ordinance No. 2014-05 entitled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas Amending Encinitas Municipal Code Section 2.20 Regarding Duties and Salary for Elected Mayor, Deputy Mayor and Council Members."
2014-05-14 Item 08D - Ordinance 2014-05 Mayor, Deputy Mayor, Council Duties and Salary
8E.
Encina Wastewater Authority Fiscal Year 2015 Operating and Capital Budgets. Contact Person: Public Works Analyst Wilson
Adopt Resolution No. 2014-37, approving the Encina Wastewater Authority Fiscal Year 2015 Operating Budget and Resolution No. 2014-38, approving the Encina Wastewater Authority Fiscal Year 2015 Capital Budget.
2014-05-14 Item 08E - Encina Wastewater Authority 2015 Budget
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
12A.
Council initiated item from Deputy Mayor Muir regarding the implementation of a
temporary hiring freeze and assessment of any newly created position from 2013 to include future positions.
2014-05-14 Item 12A - Council Initiated Item
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
City Manager's Proposed FY14/15 Operating and Capital Budget and the Six Year Financial Plan. Contact Person: Finance Director Nash
Provide an intent motion to approve; 1) The FY14/15 Operating budget changes and adjustments; 2) The organizational changes; and 3) The funding of identified Strategic Plan initiatives.
2014-05-14 Item 10A - City Manager's Proposed Operating and Capital Budget, Six Year Financial Plan
10B.
Public Hearing related to the adjustment of Traffic Mitigation Fees, and introduction of Ordinance 2014-04, amending Municipal Code Chapter 23.94, regarding traffic mitigation fees. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Deane
1) Conduct a Public Hearing related to the Traffic Mitigation Fees and introduction of Ordinance 2014-04; 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014-24, approving the Traffic Mitigation Fees and annual escalator; 3) Introduce Ordinance 2014-04, amending Municipal Code Chapter 23.94, regarding Traffic Mitigation Fees and return on June 11, 2014 for adoption of Ordinance 2014-04.
2014-05-14 Item 10B - Public Hearing Traffic Mitigation Fees
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS There are no Informational Items.
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2014-05-14 Item 15 - City Manager Follow Up Log
16.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
